# Renter op, aktier ned - frygten lurer inden vigtigt nøgletal

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Euroinvestor Millionærklubben episode aired on 11 September 2026, the 25th anniversary of 9/11. Markets were cautious: the ECB had just raised rates, oil was near 108, and investors were waiting for US CPI data. In a listener Q&A, panellists Lars Persson (technical analysis) and Lav/Lars Svendsen (fundamentals) gave views on Nordic and European stocks. They were bullish on TORM and cautiously constructive on Novo Nordisk, and avoided expensive or downtrending names such as Siemens Energy and Hemnet. Car makers and luxury goods were described as facing headwinds.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 TRMD A — TORM | **HOLD** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Lav targets 240-300 and sees 20-30% upside left before selling. Earnings are strong and the Oaktree overhang is resolved.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lav: after a 14 DKK dividend, effective price is about 238. NAV is about 236 and the company earns around 12 DKK/quarter. The product tanker shortage should keep ships sailing. He holds more TORM than ever and would not sell before 240-300.

#### Sell Triggers

- price reaches 240-300 target
- product shortage keeps oil in local markets, reducing tanker trade
- Hafnia sells its 14% stake

> *"Så der burde jo være en 20-30 procent tilbage, inden vi skal sige farvel til ham."*

---

### 🟢 NOVO B — Novo Nordisk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lav is adding the next third of his position below the 300 floor. Lars is technically negative, with possible support at 250.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lav thinks Novo is regaining control; its oral tablet is effectively alone in the market, and US price cuts may hurt less than feared because existing rebates are removed. The main risk is a de-rating of Lilly. Lars Persson sees sell signals on his models and falling momentum, and says it could go to 250 first.

#### Sell Triggers

- Eli Lilly valuation de-rates, dragging Novo
- US price cuts from 1 January hit margins more than expected
- breaks below 250 support

> *"jeg tror, at jeg skal have fat på den næste tredjedel"*

---

### ⛔ ENR — Siemens Energy | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Lav says it is unreasonably expensive and will not touch it, despite a good business and upside from Ukraine reconstruction.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lav: good operations in wind, gas turbines and grid, and a possible exit from thermal power, but the valuation is insanely high after a 200% run.

#### Sell Triggers

- valuation compresses to reasonable levels

> *"den er så urimelig dyr, at jeg vil ikke røre ved den"*

---

### ⛔ HEM — Hemnet | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Linear downtrend from 400 to under 100 after buybacks stopped. Not on Lars' momentum candidate list.

#### Reasoning

Host Lars Persson: removing buyback support removed the 'invisible hand', and the market sold off. The steady falling trend and zero momentum mean it does not qualify in his screen.

#### Sell Triggers

- momentum turns and it re-enters the candidate list

> *"Den er ikke engang på kandidatbænken. Den er helt ude."*

---

### 🟢 BMW — BMW | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lav bought at 68, thinking autos are bottoming and BMW is surprisingly cheap. Lars refuses autos.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lav: flexible drivetrain platforms and premium positioning, but margin guidance was cut to 1-3% and it loses its engine advantage in EVs. The Chinese threat is large. Lars Persson calls it a race to the bottom.

#### Sell Triggers

- Chinese EV competition erodes premium segment
- further margin downgrades

> *"jeg har købt på 68 her for midt i august, fordi jeg troede, at den og folkevogn var ved at være i bund"*

---

### 🟢 VOW3 — Volkswagen | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lav bought at 88 (now 81-82), betting car makers are at the bottom.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lav thinks VW, BMW and Mercedes should be near the bottom. Lars Persson sees nothing for shareholders when Chinese competitors undercut on price.

#### Sell Triggers

- Chinese price competition intensifies

> *"Folkevogn og Mercedes. Men det er jo fordi, de også har lastbiler. Og de har BMWs. Dem burde være i bunden nu."*

---

### 🟡 CHEMM — Chemometec | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down 3-6% on conservative guidance, but the uptrend is intact. Resistance at 520-525; the Roche cooperation could drive upside.

#### Reasoning

Host Lars Persson: the market hoped for 15% growth and got 10%, and some profit-taking is likely after the spring rally. Uptrend intact, so no need to be nervous. The Roche partnership is exciting, but partnerships often underdeliver.

#### Sell Triggers

- uptrend breaks
- Roche partnership fails to generate orders

> *"Men det er jo en stadigvæk opadgående trend, så man skal jo ikke blive nervøs."*

---

### 🟡 ALK B — ALK-Abelló | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Testing 200 support in a falling trend, possibly down to 160. Expensive at a P/E of about 37. Only for a 5-10 year horizon.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson: falling trend, looks tired, and is hard to play short-term, with support maybe at 160. Lav: a long-term winner that is still expensive; keep it with a 5-10 year view, otherwise find better uses of the money.

#### Sell Triggers

- breaks 200 support toward 160
- growth pipeline stalls

> *"Hvis du har det perspektiv, kan du beholde den med. Ellers vil jeg sige, find noget bedre at bruge pengene på."*

---

### 🟡 SAGA — Saga PLC | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Short-term strained, but the long-term uptrend from 300 to 600 is intact. Suggested stop-loss 8-9% below the current price.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson likes the case, since an ageing population gives tailwinds as for Swedish care home companies. Technically weak short term, so protect with a stop-loss.

#### Sell Triggers

- falls 8-9% below current price

> *"Måske skulle man lægge en stoploss for en 8-9% under den nuværende kurs."*

---

### 🟠 NKR — Nekkar | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Persson is analysing Norwegian oil service stocks and expects a service catch-up in 2027-28. The stock is flattening at 14-15.

#### Reasoning

Oil installations are being run hard without maintenance, so once supply normalises, service demand should rise. Persson has not yet dug into Nekkar specifically, and momentum has faded.

#### Sell Triggers

- no order intake
- Middle East conflict persists delaying maintenance cycle

> *"Så dem vil jeg holde øje med til 27-28."*

---

### 🟠 UMI — Umicore | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Turnaround in batteries and metal recycling. Lav thinks the listener is onto something and it is not especially expensive; Lars prefers it over car makers.

#### Reasoning

Structural trends in electrification, EU independence and the circular economy, with favourable metal prices. It had a bad 2024 on the EV battery slump, and more study is needed.

#### Sell Triggers

- EV battery demand weakens again
- metal prices fall

> *"jeg tror, det er det rigtige du lugter"*

---

### 🟠 MC — LVMH | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Looks cheap, but faces headwinds from higher rates and a weak economy. Keep it on the bench until good times return.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson: revenue is up, but the market fears fewer wealthy customers in a downturn. He would bring it in when the macro turns. Lav avoids luxury brand valuation.

#### Sell Triggers

- market crash reduces wealthy customer base
- Asian demand weakens

> *"så kan det da godt være, at man skal hive den ind for kandidatbænken"*

---

### 🟠 ALIV — Autoliv | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars prefers component suppliers like Autoliv, which have pricing power, over car makers.

#### Reasoning

Suppliers of airbags and similar parts know what to charge, unlike car makers in a race to the bottom.

> *"Dem der leverer til Autoliv Altså alle dem der leverer komponenter derinde De ved godt hvad de skal have for det"*

---

### 🟡 GMAB — Genmab | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Persson is a long-term owner and content while earnings keep growing. The EGM on board pay is not yet reviewed.

#### Reasoning

A long-held position; the governance issue is noted but not assessed.

#### Sell Triggers

- earnings stop growing
- governance issues escalate

> *"så længe der drykker noget ned på bundlinjen til mig, og gerne lidt mere hver år, så er jeg egentlig en glad mand"*

---
